citations.claim: cart exceeds track at first violating step, pole still upright
three steps earlier cart already near end and moving outward while pole balanced

counterfactual.change: changed initial.v from 0.448 to 0.0; without initial outward velocity cart never drifts off, so failure removed

explanation: Controller balances pole but does not regulate cart position back to center: with initial outward velocity v~0.45, cart drifts steadily outward (x 0.45 at step 200, 1.23 at step 400, 2.03 at step 500) while pole stays balanced (theta~0.08, margin~0.72 at step 533) and controller force stays small positive (~0.8N), so cart sails past x=2.4 at step 533.

violation.detail: cart at x=2.403 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The cart is positioned at the far right end of the track with the pole held upright through steps 530 to 532. By step 533 the cart has driven past the track end while the pole remains vertical and balanced.
